prompt.en: Why could village assemblies be called independent and self-reliant? Answer in about 100 words, using the Chola villages and the kudavolai.

label.en: Assemblies did the local work themselves

level1.en: What work did a village assembly do?

clue.en: Village assemblies settled disputes and were responsible for all local administrative functions, including revenue collection, land management, irrigation, road construction and record maintenance.

clue.en: Under the kudavolai, names of eligible candidates were drawn from a pot by a young child in full view of the community. Those chosen were divided into committees called variyams.
